pick.headline: John Paul II begins his first pilgrimage to Poland
pick.fbis: The Eastern Europe Daily Report of June 4, 1979, listed how bloc media reported the Pope's arrival: Sofia radio, ADN on his activities in Warsaw, and Budapest radio.
